'''High Security Lockdown''' was a district on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. A hidden annex of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district of [[Shadow Town]], it was also home to a number of refugees.
